description: Extract all text from a PDF — page by page with PDF.js — then copy it or download it as a plain .txt file.

faqs.a: Text-based PDFs (reports, ebooks, invoices) extract cleanly. Scanned image-only PDFs contain no text data, so nothing can be extracted.
faqs.q: Why is my scanned PDF's text empty?

faqs.a: Yes — text is grouped by page with a “Page N” header, in the document's reading order.
faqs.q: Is the text organized by page?

faqs.a: Tables, columns and fancy layouts may extract out of visual order — that is how the text is stored in the PDF.
faqs.q: Why does the text order look odd?

faqs.a: No — extraction runs locally with PDF.js in your browser.

howto: Wait for the text to be extracted page by page.
Read, search or copy the extracted text.
Download it as a .txt file if you need it.
title: PDF to Text Extractor
